claim: A multi-stage reasoning pipeline comprising parsing, search, and confirmation stages progressively improves navigation performance in aerial vision-and-dialog navigation tasks.
falsifier: One could implement a similar multi-stage pipeline and measure navigation performance metrics (e.g., success rate, path length) on aerial navigation benchmarks, comparing against single-stage baselines.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task, population, and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Multi-stage reasoning pipeline for navigation performance
